title: User markers and a user connector with access to its markers
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG7.5 (docs/dev/design/pythonUserItems.md 5.3, 5.4): user markers (position, orientation, coordinates; on a node or a body); a user connector whose user function gets the functions of its markers as Python objects per call and returns the forces; example 5: a sphere rolling on a flexible cable.
releaseNotes: ObjectConnectorUser: a connector whose Python user function gets its markers as exudyn.ConnectorMarker objects - it reads them, also any point of a marker's body, and applies forces and torques through them; the user markers continue in #3065
